summary: Executed focused backend+frontend verification for premium checkout and post-purchase entitlements using qa.nom.premium@example.com. Completed ACTUAL RevenueCat Test Store flow including provider-side "Test valid purchase"; backend plan switched to premium and usage limits became null. Added new pure unit tests for meal_suggestions normalization and feed_me single-retry/error-record behavior, plus API regression tests for premium/free plan boundaries and saved-meal caps.

integration_issues.issue: After provider confirmation, paywall did not always render a deterministic on-screen success marker (`already-premium`/toast state capture timed out), although backend entitlement mirror completed and plan became premium.

action_items: Optional hardening: add explicit UI success state after provider confirmation (beyond backend mirror log) so automation/users can deterministically see purchase completion.
Keep monitoring RevenueCat->/me/entitlement mirror with current diagnostic logs in production-like runs.
critical_code_review_comments: `frontend/src/api.ts` stale-401 guard behaved correctly in race test: delayed unauthorized pre-login request did not clear newly saved token.

`frontend/src/auth-context.tsx` mirror sequencing showed expected behavior in logs: old free mirror then fresh premium mirror with `[RevenueCat] entitlement mirrored` payload including appUserId/premium/serverPlan.
`backend/meal_suggestions.py` normalization/validation now handles nested numeric strings, NaN/missing rejects, derived calories, and macro-energy consistency checks as covered by unit tests.

success_rate.frontend: 90% for requested premium scope (checkout+provider confirmation+entitlement/account-switch validated; UI success marker nondeterministic)

seed_data_creation: Created and deleted one temporary free test account for free saved-meal cap isolation: test_i6_freecap_<timestamp>@example.com.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Premium QA account is now active premium via real Test Store valid purchase. Re-login/account switch checks passed (premium upsell hidden for premium, visible for free). Usage limits null for premium and finite for free.
rca_of_issue: Previous failures were largely incomplete checkout runs stopping before provider confirmation. In this run, once Test Store 'Test valid purchase' was clicked, network sequence showed `/v1/receipts` followed by `/api/me/entitlement` mirror to `premium:true`, and `/api/auth/me` + `/api/me/usage` confirmed backend premium state.
